title: Introduce agent context window, token budget, truncation, and compression boundaries
description: AstrBot keeps context manager, compressor, truncator, and token counter as explicit agent-context concerns. Rust currently only injects session context through pipeline ports, so main-agent parity needs a separate context-window boundary before request decoration grows.

files.change: Define typed context-window traits and policies before main-agent request decoration or tool-loop work expands.
Avoid embedding token counting, truncation, or compression logic directly in pipeline stages.

criteria: Context compression/truncation is independent from concrete provider adapters.
Pipeline stages keep consuming typed ProviderRequest/context results through ports.
Token estimation is pluggable and testable without LLM calls.
